audience: product and search teams that tune Algolia indices, records and synonyms

useCases.title: Check indices and their sizes
useCases.text: List the indices with entry counts, sizes and update times, then read the settings of one index.

useCases.title: Test a search before a release
useCases.text: Run a search on one index, or several queries in one call, and read the facet values of one facet.

useCases.title: Review synonyms and query rules
useCases.text: Search the synonyms and query rules of an index, then read one of them by its object id.

useCases.title: Update a record and confirm it
useCases.text: Partially update the attributes of one record, then check the returned write task until it is published.

useCases.title: Investigate failed API calls
useCases.text: Read the API log entries of the last seven days, newest first, to find failed calls and their causes.
